title: Cache eviction report over-reports one namespace's live entries
summary: The overnight cache eviction report shows more live entries for one namespace than the cache's metrics endpoint, so the capacity-planning on-call cannot trust it.

company.notes: In-memory cache eviction sweep over a write log; subtle logic flaw, no syntax error, no crash.

expected_output:
=== Live entries by namespace ===
catalog: 2
feed: 2
search: 3
sessions: 2
buggy_output:
=== Live entries by namespace ===
catalog: 2
feed: 2
search: 3
sessions: 3

phase2.spec_patch: Ops also needs pinned entries to survive the sweep: a pinned entry is never evicted, even once it is expired, because those keys are hand-warmed and must stay resident. The pinned flag is already the optional fourth column on every write. Keep the same header and per-row format.
phase2.expected_output_v2:
=== Live entries by namespace ===
catalog: 2
feed: 2
search: 4
sessions: 3
